channel.name: legs
channel.purpose: Leg and ankle: design, drop test, gait gantry

quirks: ALL CAPS for part numbers and deadlines

context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: Six-axis sensor drifts with temperature and bolt preload. This week: Mei: Fz zero drifts ~12 N over a 20 min run.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists. This week: Marcus: show the leg on the gantry plus hip and hand separately; no torso.
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: First drops at 15 cm fine; 30 cm drop leaves a crack at the shank clevis fillet.
Ongoing: Replace foot switches with a learned contact estimate from joint currents

dates other than those in the claim
stating which shipping tier was chosen
